patch_description: Add a deterministic derivative-free local search after the contact-force polishing. The exact minimum/maximum distance objective is nonsmooth: when a closest or diameter pair changes, its averaged contact-force direction can cease to be improving and the existing force loop stops. Single-point random-direction moves with exact-ratio acceptance can cross these contact-switch boundaries while preserving every accepted improvement. The step size contracts only after an unsuccessful sweep, providing a narrow final refinement without materially increasing runtime.
